thread:
Jules Kramer: Quick heads-up 0: opened a docs PR to clarify SOC2 wording and add an audit-logs + retention example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/859

Ana M.: Nice. Legal prefers phrases like 'customers may configure' rather than 'we retain'. Can you reword the intro?

Jules Kramer: Yep rephrased to neutral language and added a short 'how to configure retention' note.

Ravi Singh: Need an SDK snippet (py + curl) to show how to request audit exports. Also update the endpoint; backend changed it to /v1/admin/audit-logs last week.

Jules Kramer: Updated examples to /v1/admin/audit-logs and added a Python snippet:
```python
# export audit logs (admin)
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=TOKEN)
logs = client.admin.audit_logs.list(start_time='2025-03-01T00:00:00Z', page_size=100)
```
Added curl example for SRE smoke checks.

Ana M.: Add a caveat that retention settings may be overridden by legal/regulatory requirements. Also avoid verb "keep" for logs.

Jules Kramer: Replaced wording, added the legal caveat. Also swapped an internal doc link to the public SOC2 mapping PDF: https://redwood-inference.com/compliance/soc2-mapping.pdf

DevSecOps Bot: Lint results: code-block-language-missing in one snippet. Security flag: phrase "we store logs" -> please change to neutral/configurable phrasing.

Jules Kramer: Fixed code block languages and updated flagged phrase. Marking PR ready for review and adding a short migration checklist for Dedicated customers (endpoints, webhooks, key rotation). Assigning to @Ana M. for legal review. :white_check_mark:
